name: key-value-list
title: Key value list
description: Technical facts you copy: IDs, URLs and hashes in mono, a copy button per row, long values cut in the middle, secrets masked.
docs: items are { label, value, copyable, mono, secret, href }. It is the description list's dl markup, so a screen reader hears the same terms and values. A copyable row's button is named 'Copy order ID' and confirms with 'Copied order ID'; a secret stays dots until its reveal button is pressed and hides again after hideSecretsAfter seconds; a long string value gives up its middle, with the whole text in a tooltip and for a screen reader. A value with an href is underlined at rest, and a link to another site (https://) carries a small arrow. A secret needs a string value: any other node stays dots with no reveal button, and development logs an error. layout 'columns' puts the labels beside the values once the list is 28rem wide; it measures its own width, so give it a box that has one.
